verdict.rationale: BVNK documents a dedicated conversion API: Transfers v3 replaces the legacy Quote API for wallet-to-wallet currency conversion. It also generates live quotes per payment and supports fiat-to-stablecoin on-ramp rules and fiat/stablecoin funding and payout flows, so quotes and executed conversions are a real API surface. The evidence does not show documented rates, fee schedules, or settlement times; the only fee evidence is a partner markup. Missing for 10: documented conversion rates/spreads, fee schedules, settlement-time commitments, explicit stablecoin-to-stablecoin conversion, independent or hands-on corroboration.
